Claim: PM loop round 24 (p3 only, by the maintainer's order 「你后续只处理 p3」) · 2026-10-21T08:55Z · p3, `domain:engine` (triage's grade), filed by `repo:hotcrm` seat 2 from objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2207's v18 Setup pass, F-03. An administrator opening another user's record in Setup sees a Security tab of four "your account" sections, all of them empty: "Password & Sign-in — Change your password or the email address associated with this account", "Two-Factor Authentication", "Email Verification", and "Danger Zone — … your account cannot be recovered". Every action under them is gated to the viewer's own record, so on someone else's record only the headings remain, and they address the administrator as if the account were theirs.
Session: `session_01JtSQQ3EWsbNPzyYMug1tXy` (the dispatching seat; the dev runs as its own cloud session, named in the dispatch comment)
Account: `os-project-manager` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-24938-security-tab-own-record`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24938`
Domain: `domain:engine`
Seat: `domain:engine#1` (seat post #6367)
File surface:
- **Measured first:**
  - the Security tab in `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/sys-user.page.ts`: its `element:text` headings and captions and its `record:quick_actions`;
  - whether a page tab item, and a component node inside it, honour the ADR-0089 component-node `visibleWhen`. The same page already gates its unverified-email `record:alert` with ``P`has(record.id) && … && record.id == ctx.user.id …` `` and explains why the `P` envelope is load-bearing on a raw `Page` literal. Read the spec's page schema and objectui's page renderer (read only);
  - what the Security tab holds that is NOT self-service, if anything, and what an administrator does see there on another user's record today.
- `sys-user.page.ts`, the Security tab only: the self-service sections show only on the viewer's own record (`record.id == ctx.user.id`, with the `has()` guards, in the `P` envelope). Either the whole tab is gated, or each "your account" heading and caption is, whichever the schema and renderer support and the measurement favours. Translate by the repo's rule if any text changes.
- **Pins:** a metadata pin that each self-service section, or the tab, carries the own-record gate in the CEL envelope. Ablation: remove the gate, and the pin goes red. A browser reading is welcome but not owed: own record → the sections show; another user's record → they do not.
- **The changeset:** `patch` for `@objectstack/platform-objects`.

⛔ Not in scope:
- the actions' own gates in `sys-user.object.ts` (already own-record);
- admin actions on another user's security (no new action);
- the tab strip running past 1440 px (the card names it as unverified and not this card);
- the API Keys and Preferences tabs;
- objectui's renderer, and any spec key. If the gate cannot be declared without one, the dev reports `needs_decision` and does not widen.

Container & model: `S`, `mode:cloud` (page metadata gates, their pin, and a schema and renderer read), `model: TIER_DEFAULT` (this run's `dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no (platform metadata only: the Security tab's self-service sections are shown on the viewer's own record only; no action, param, response, spec key or export moves)
Responsibility: an administrator reading another user's record is shown empty "your account" sections that speak to them | the Security tab's self-service text carries no own-record gate, though every action under it does | every administrator who opens a user record in Setup
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared: the 12 open PRs' file lists and the `pm:dispatched` claims were read at this claim, on `origin/main` `4feccc2685`. No open PR touches `sys-user.page.ts` or `packages/platform-objects/src/pages/`. No held claim names that file.

**What `main` now holds:**
- **An administrator viewing another user's record no longer sees that record's Security tab.** The tab's four "your account" sections were empty on anyone else's record and spoke to the administrator as if the account were theirs. The tab now shows only on the viewer's own record, where its controls work: change password and email, two-factor authentication, email verification, and account deletion.
- **How:** the tab item carries the own-record gate `has(record.id) && record.id == ctx.user.id` as its `visibleWhen`, in the CEL envelope the page's unverified-email alert already uses. objectui's tab renderer then omits both the tab header and its panel.
- **Unchanged:** the actions and their own gates, the other tabs, and the viewer's own record.
- **Shipped as:** `patch` of `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `Clause-②: no (platform metadata only: …)`.

**Beside it:** no file outside `packages/platform-objects` moved. One side effect is noted in the PR and not filed. The page's tab items carry no `value`, so on another user's record the `?tab=` tokens of API Keys and Preferences shift down by one. Only a `?tab=` link copied from one's own record to someone else's is affected.
